hana (Finance): /look INV-2026-0733 for OrionInc (private) - Platform Fee appears twice and support shows Enterprise though they requested Standard before renewal. Can someone confirm?

kevin (Account Manager): Pulling contract. They requested downgrade on 2026-04-15 via ticket SUP-1102. Will attach.

hana (Finance): Invoice lines: Platform Fee $13,000; Platform Fee $13,000; Support - Enterprise $28,000; True-up $1,980. Total $55,980.

mina (Cloud Ops): Support-sync failed for OrionInc during renewal window; ticket SUP-1102 recorded. Also we had a one-time migration credit on file (SETT-ORION-2026) that should suppress migration charge, but I don't see a migration line here. Might be duplicate platform fee created by legacy vs new billing code mapping.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0733 generated 2026-04-10T07:40Z by billing-service v3.5.2

olga (Head of Finance): Approve issuing credit memo to correct duplicate platform fee and prorate support. Please include audit memo and references SUP-1102 and SETT-ORION-2026. Assign CM-2026-0745.

kevin (Account Manager): I'll draft the customer note for post-credit communication. hana, please create AR request and attach docs.

hana (Finance): AR request created. CM-2026-0745 queued. ETA posting 2 business days. Filing billing bug BILL-498 to prevent duplicate mapping and add pre-invoice checks for support-tier mismatches.

kevin (Account Manager): Notifying AM team. Will wait for CM to post before emailing customer. :thumbsup:
